p = [0] * 17
for i in range(1, 17):
    p[i] = p[i-1] * 10 + 1

def solve(n, length):
    q = n // p[length]
    r = n % p[length]
    if r == 0:
        return q * length
    else:
        return q * length + min(solve(r, length-1), length + solve(p[length] - r, length-1))

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    ans = solve(n, 16)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
